parsed.rationale: I agree it's RBBB: V1 has a broad, mostly upright rSR' complex and V2 an M-shaped one, both with secondary ST depression and T-wave inversion, and leads I and V6 show slurred S waves at about 120 ms, while no leads show ST elevation that meets STEMI criteria.
